AUTHOR: Lopez-Vazquez
TITLE: Video Image Enhancement and Machine Learning Pipeline for Underwater Animal Detection and Classification at Cabled Observatories
REGION: LoVe Ocean Observatory, Hola trough off Lofoten Islands, Norway (260 m depth, cold-water coral reef)
SPECIES: Fish classes: rockfish (Sebastes sp.), eel-like fish (Brosme brosme), generic 'fish'; other classes: king crab, squid, starfish, hermit crab, anemone, shrimp, sea urchin, crab, coral, plus 'turbidity' and 'shadow'
DATA: Own LoVe observatory time-lapse stills (8,818 images, 60-min interval, Oct 2017-Jun 2019); 1,934 manually selected segmented elements (90-200 per class), training 80% augmented to 39,072
V_EV: Sec. 2.4: 'heterogeneous background of coral bushes, where turbidity and artificial lighting changes make it difficult to detect elements'; depth 260 m stated; turbidity only a visual class, no NTU values used
D_EV: Sec. 2.6: 'every classifier was validated by 10-fold cross-validation by considering that the elements of each class were distributed evenly in each one of the folds.'
R_EV: Sec. 3: count check 'performed on images not used during the training and test phase, corresponding to the period from 17 November 2017 to 22 November 2017'
C_EV: Sec. 2.4: 'A binary thresholding value, which was chosen by testing different values, was performed' (segmentation threshold; no value or score threshold)
E_EV: Sec. 3 / Fig. 8: 'The classifier detected rockfish in 27 images, whereas with the manual detection, animals were detected in 24 images'; six-day detection time series vs manual detection
ARCH: Image enhancement (CLAHE, bilateral filter) + daily-average background subtraction + thresholding/contours for detection; global features (Hu moments, Haralick, colour histogram) fed to SVM, K-NN, DT, RF and 4 small CNNs / 4 DNNs (Keras-style, on 1D feature vectors); best DNN-1 acc 76.18%, AUC 87.59%
METR: Accuracy, AUC (macro-averaged), loss, confusion matrices; detections per day vs manual
NOTE: Mixed-taxa megafauna pipeline; fish are 3 of 13 classes (rockfish, Brosme, generic fish). Split: 80/20 of segmented elements with 10-fold CV - unit is element/image, not day; could also be coded k-fold(이미지), D_ALL = N either way. Fig. 8 comparison (27 automated vs 24 manual rockfish images, 'at least three false positives'; 'In the other time series, the difference is much higher') could be read as C5 = 검증 표본 오탐률 (then C_ALL = P); coded conservatively as 없음 because it is a count comparison on 80 images, not a per-detection verification with a FP rate - verifier should decide. Satellite 1 records turbidity sensor data but it is not used in the analysis. Classifiers are not pretrained (transfer learning explicitly left as future work). 'Accuracy 76.18% / AUC 87.59%' is from the held-out test/CV split, not an external dataset. Text file contains duplicated/garbled layout from a 2022 correction overlay.
